description_en: Queries the cross-region log backup files of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询跨地域日志备份文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-cross-region-log-backup-files --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cross-backup-region cn-shanghai --start-time 2019-05-30T12:10:00Z --end-time 2019-06-15T12:10:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCrossRegionLogBackupFiles

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region within which the cross-region backup file is stored. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackupDBInstance operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份目的地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeCrossRegionBackupDBInstance查看地域ID
parameters.name: cross_backup_region

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number
